title: Degree Bounds for Generic Initial Ideals of Arrangements
statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ be a central arrangement in $K^\ell$, let $S=K[x_1,\ldots,x_\ell]$, and set
$$
d_0=\min\{d:x_1^d\in\operatorname{rgin}(J(\mathcal A))\}.
$$
If a minimal generator $t$ of $\operatorname{rgin}(J(\mathcal A))$ involves $x_3$, must $\deg(t)\geq d_0$?
